description:
Outcome: Demonstrate first-version mobile journeys, from brief.md First version must 1–4 and Constraints; owner deferred requirement 5
Scope: Synthetic-data application, coordinator application/allocation list, own-allocation, problem-report and triage screens; large text, plain language, keyboard and screen-reader labels. Excludes: live backend and plot map/grid
Acceptance: Both roles can navigate complete phone journeys; representative empty, loading and error states; contact details coordinator-only
Behaviour: Accessible errors, recoverable form values, clear pending/success states
Verification: Prototype walkthrough, mobile viewport and keyboard/screen-reader checks. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: proposed vocabulary and layout, reviewed at T-004
title: Mobile journey prototype
